verdict.rationale: Any public web service could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to the ANEF portal. The pack has no evidence of either: the probes show the ANEF host serves only a ~3 KB JavaScript shell to keyless agents, and the parent ministry site returns a Cloudflare 403 challenge. Neither probe checked a /llms.txt path directly, so confidence is medium rather than high.
